name: Haas-ja-v1.0

lineage.how_derived: FastConformer encoder + TDT decoder with the LSTM prediction network replaced by Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)

purpose: Fast and accurate Japanese speech recognition on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of five public Japanese datasets (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Front matter and badge say Apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo (404); text not read.

architecture.kind: FastConformer (24 layers, hidden 1024) + TDT with 2-layer Kimi Delta Attention prediction network, 615.8M parameters, SentencePiece BPE 3072 tokens

pc-12gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-16gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-24gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

pc-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-16-24gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-32gb.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

mac-64gb+.notes: tiny model, fits every class with room for a resident LLM

other: NeMo 2.7 + flash-linear-attention (Triton/CUDA): no CPU, no macOS
engine_support.notes: The KDA prediction network needs CUDA kernels, so it is NVIDIA-only as shipped.

benchmarks.name: asr-ja-bench (5 public Japanese datasets), CER strict
benchmarks.harness: authors' own benchmark and metric (jacer); card calls it the most accurate of the open models they evaluated

tona_fit.reason: Japanese-only; no German relevance. Listed as a Japanese reference.
